taughtAsSubject: All secondary schools teach Chichewa, alongside English and Mathematics
Chichewa sits in the core set of ten secondary subjects rather than among the electives
Chichewa is a primary subject area assessed at Standard 4 and at Standard 7
The 2008 PCAR primary curriculum emphasises literacy in English and Chichewa
The Education Act 2013 leaves the language of instruction to a ministerial Gazette notice

sources.label: Education Act 2013 (Chapter 30:01), section 78 Language of instruction, consolidated to 31 December 2014 (MalawiLII / Laws.Africa)
Government of the Republic of Malawi, Malawi Education Sector Analysis (2019), primary and secondary curriculum and MLA 2015 sections

taughtAsSubject: Zambian Languages is offered as a core subject for all on the Academic Career Pathway
Junior secondary timetables it at 3hrs 20min a week, five periods
In the senior Technology curriculum Zambian Language is one of the optional subjects
At Grades 1 to 4 all learning areas are taught in familiar Zambian Languages
English remains the official medium of instruction from Grade 5 up to tertiary

sources.label: Ministry of Education, Science, Vocational Training and Early Education, The Zambia Education Curriculum Framework 2013, Curriculum Development Centre, Lusaka

taughtAsSubject: Regional and minority languages are absent from primary, secondary and vocational education
Ministries must secure supplementary extra-curricular optional classes about the languages
Italian and Ukrainian run as optional classes two hours a week in a few Prnjavor schools
At secondary level such optional classes do not exist, the Committee of Experts records
Teaching about minority history and culture is still not part of the compulsory curricula

sources.label: Council of Europe, Committee of Experts, Fourth evaluation report on Bosnia and Herzegovina under the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, MIN-LANG (2026) 2, education section paras 23-27
Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles, Langues, Lettres & Livre, Langues et Cultures régionales en classe — FAQ

taughtAsSubject: The national plan d'etudes carries German, French and Luxembourgish at cycles 2 to 4
Cycle 1 has its own domain, language and Luxembourgish with awakening to languages
Luxembourgish is the language of instruction at cycle 1 and German at cycles 2, 3 and 4
Cycle 4 work includes listening to extracts of Luxembourgish literature read aloud

sources.label: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale, de l'Enfance et de la Jeunesse, Plan d'études — École fondamentale (règlement grand-ducal du 11 août 2011), domaines Langue luxembourgeoise cycles 1 à 4

taughtAsSubject: All three national languages are taught as components of the Languages learning area
The framework specifies the essential learning areas of the national curriculum
From the beginning of Key Stage 2 (P3) English becomes the medium for certain subjects
The area carries literacy in Kreol and the literature associated with it

sources.label: Ministry of Education, The Seychelles National Curriculum Framework, Languages essential learning area

taughtAsSubject: Sesotho is a syllabus subject whose study develops understanding of the language's structure
The Curriculum and Assessment Policy 2009 makes Sesotho a compulsory secondary subject
It sits in the Linguistic and literary learning area with English and other languages
ECoL recommends four guided hours a week, six periods of 40 minutes, over two years
Paper 3 examines Sesotho literature and culture, not the language alone

sources.label: National Curriculum Development Centre with the Examinations Council of Lesotho, Lesotho General Certificate of Secondary Education Syllabus: Sesotho 0176, for examination in November 2020

Raselimo and Mahao, The Lesotho curriculum and assessment policy: opportunities and threats, South African Journal of Education 35(1) 2015, Table 1 reproducing the MoET 2009 secondary curriculum structure

taughtAsSubject: The 2022 education law extends teaching in the national languages poular, soninke and wolof
They are carried both as languages of communication and as languages of instruction
Every child whose mother tongue is Arabic must learn at least one of the three
At primary each child studies the scientific disciplines in his or her mother tongue

sources.label: Loi n° 2022-023 portant orientation du système éducatif national (Mauritanie), articles 5 et 65, texte reproduit par L'aménagement linguistique dans le monde, Université Laval
